methodology: 12 hand-selected Thai-English/English-Thai cases. Same raw text and explicit language pair; no glossary, dialect hints or conversation. Google public signed-out desktop website, displayed mode recorded, versus app /api/translate scope=text with natural tone/general context and cache bypass. One run; qualitative inspection is not a human blind benchmark or a population accuracy score. No images/audio comparison. UI time and API time are different channels, not a fair speed ranking.
